verdict.rationale: Unreal ships as a locally-installed engine with source-code access (unreal-docs-10/18), so the core product is inherently self-hostable rather than SaaS-only. However, the probe evidence shows source access is EULA/account-gated (must link a GitHub account to Epic), the GitHub repo is not publicly discoverable via API, and there is no simple open self-hosting path comparable to fully open-source engines. Missing for 10: unrestricted/public source access, no account-gating requirement, first-party documentation framing self-hosting as an explicit feature.
